label: Free 2.0
title: Ordering, filters and replay
lede: Vector 2.0 adds ordered delivery per key, payload filters, replay and pruning to the MIT package, plus a versioned database schema. It needs Node.js 22 and a one-time store.migrate().

items.title: Ordered delivery per key
items.text: Give related messages the same orderingKey and each endpoint receives them in send order, one after the other. Other keys are not held back.
items.code:
await vector.send({ eventType: "order.created", payload, orderingKey: order.id });
await vector.send({ eventType: "order.paid", payload, orderingKey: order.id });
items.outputTitle: Received order (real run, fake receiver, three events, one key)

items.title: Payload filters on endpoints
items.text: An endpoint can limit itself to messages whose payload matches a condition, on top of its event types. Customers only get the events they care about.
items.codeTitle: Create an endpoint with a filter
items.outputTitle: Four invoices sent, two delivered (real run, fake receiver)

items.title: Replay a time range
items.text: After an outage or for a new endpoint, send stored messages of a time range again, oldest first, as new deliveries. It respects event types and filters.
items.outputTitle: Replay of the last hour (real run; deliveries shown as a count)
items.output:
replay: { messages: 3, deliveries: 3, truncated: false }
replayed in order: order.created -> order.paid -> order.shipped

items.title: Prune old messages
items.text: Delete old messages with their deliveries and attempts in batches, on every store. Messages with a pending delivery are kept. Call it from a nightly job.
items.outputTitle: Result (real run, olderThan set in the future to delete all three test messages)

items.title: Versioned database schema
items.text: Upgrading from 1.x is one call. migrate() adds what is missing and schemaVersion() tells you where the database stands.

note: Outputs come from a real run of @sweberdev/vector 2.0.0 with a fake receiver in memory. Not verified: ordered delivery on MySQL. Test receiver and Drizzle export are planned for 2.1.
